title: Free Night Awards Ownership, Cash Value and Resale Terms
content:
A Free Night Award belongs to the Ashbury Rewards membership it was issued to. The ownership terms are the same for every award type, the 25K, 35K, 40K, 50K and 85K Free Night Awards and the Any Hotel Free Night Award:

| Term | Value |
|---|---|
| The award may be moved to another member's account | No |
| Cash value of the award | 0.00 USD |
| Selling or bartering the award voids it | Yes |

1. No award type may be moved to another member's account.
2. Every award type has a cash value of 0.00 USD; an award has no value in money.
3. Selling or bartering an award of any type voids it.
